rules.install:
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin" install -m 0755 "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/src/pam-config" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin/"
# Our own addition: restricts logins of root to the consoles of the machine # with pam_securetty, which pam-config does not know about. install -m 0755 "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/extra/pam-securetty" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin/"
